description: Add 3D elements and premium visual effects across all sections. Add a floating 3D geometric scene in the Hero using React Three Fiber, enhance cards with 3D perspective tilt effects, upgrade all section animations with parallax depth and elegant entrance transitions.
steps: Create src/components/FloatingGeometry.tsx - a React Three Fiber Canvas component for the Hero section. Render floating 3D geometric shapes (icosahedron, torus, octahedron) with a gradient shader material matching the brand colors (purple #a855f7, cyan #06b6d4). Shapes should slowly rotate and float with sine-wave motion. Use drei's Float component for organic movement. Keep it performant with low poly counts and frameloop='demand' or similar optimization.

Create src/components/TiltCard.tsx - a reusable 3D perspective tilt card component. On mouse move, calculate rotation using the mouse position relative to card center (rotateX/rotateY up to 15deg). Use CSS transform with perspective(1000px). Add a subtle light/shine gradient that follows the cursor. Smooth spring transition on mouse leave back to flat. This replaces the existing inline tilt logic in Portfolio.tsx with a cleaner, reusable component.

Update src/components/Hero.tsx - integrate the FloatingGeometry component as a background/side element. Add a subtle parallax depth effect where the text content moves at a different rate than the 3D shapes. Enhance the gradient blobs with more sophisticated animation (morphing shapes or pulsing). Add a scroll-based fade-out so the hero content elegantly dissolves as user scrolls into the next section.

Update src/components/Services.tsx - wrap each service card in TiltCard for 3D hover effects. Add staggered entrance animations with scale + rotation (cards should appear to flip/rotate in from slight 3D angles). Add floating particle dots or subtle grid pattern in the section background for depth.

Update src/components/Portfolio.tsx - replace the existing inline tilt with TiltCard component. Add a parallax depth effect where cards at different grid positions have slightly different scroll speeds. Add a subtle glow/reflection effect on hover.

Update src/components/Process.tsx - enhance the timeline with 3D depth. Steps should appear to emerge from a vanishing point with perspective transform. The connecting line should have a glowing animated gradient that pulses. Add subtle floating dots/particles around the timeline.

Update src/components/Pricing.tsx - add 3D tilt to pricing cards using TiltCard. The 'popular' card should have a constant subtle floating animation (translateY oscillation). Add a radial gradient glow behind the popular card.

Update src/components/Testimonials.tsx - add depth to the carousel with 3D perspective on the scrolling container. Cards further from center should appear to recede (smaller scale, rotated slightly on Y axis). Add subtle parallax between the heading and carousel.

Update src/components/Contact.tsx - add a subtle 3D floating animation to the form card. The info column icons should have staggered bounce-in animations. Add a gradient mesh background element behind the section.

Update src/utils/animations.ts - add new sophisticated animation variants: flipInX (3D card flip entrance), rotateInFromLeft/Right (3D rotation entrance), floatUpAndFade (parallax scroll-based fade), elasticScale (bouncy scale entrance), glowPulse (for ambient elements). These should use spring physics with proper damping/stiffness values for premium feel.

Update src/index.css - add CSS for 3D perspective containers (preserve-3d, perspective utilities), floating animation keyframes, ambient glow effects, and particle/dot patterns as CSS background patterns. Add a subtle noise texture overlay for premium feel.
acceptance_criteria: Hero section has floating 3D geometric shapes rendered with React Three Fiber
Cards across Services, Portfolio, Pricing sections have smooth 3D perspective tilt on hover
Each section has unique, elegant entrance animation with 3D depth (not just simple fade-in-up)
Process timeline has glowing animated gradient line and 3D perspective emergence
Testimonial carousel has 3D depth with perspective transforms
Overall feel is premium and visually impressive with smooth 60fps animations
Reduced motion preferences are still respected
Build passes: bun run build succeeds with zero errors
verification: Run 'bun run build' and confirm zero errors in output
